subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Derogatory
solution:
The correct answer is: **Insulting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"derogatory"** means showing a critical or disrespectful attitude. (अपमानजनक)
 
 
• **Example: **His derogatory comments about her work were completely uncalled for.
 
 
 
• **"Insulting"** refers to something that is disrespectful or scornful. (अपमानजनक)
 
 
• **Example: **Calling someone lazy can be very insulting.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'derogatory' **is **'insulting'**.
